summary: Use when the user asks for a sleek, modern Mermaid / PlantUML diagram (e.g. "beautify this flowchart", "make this look like a deck slide", "produce an SVG of this architecture"), wants AI to generate a diagram from a text description, wants a public share link for a diagram, wants to render every diagram file in a folder, or wants to render Mermaid / PlantUML fenced code blocks inside a Markdown file (README, docs) into images. This skill teaches you to call the Beauty Diagram CLI (`bd`) — never to hand-author SVG when a source diagram exists.
